_readme: Standing per-lodge rules for the Warehouse Board (wall.html). Applied automatically from the live Beds24 feed — no dated note needed. 'owner_departure' shows its message whenever the board sees that lodge's OWNER departing, both on the day and up to lookahead days ahead (currently 1 day). To add a lodge: add its code with an 'owner_departure' message. Same message can differ per lodge.

CR79.owner_departure: Owner normally strips our bedding and uses their own, and usually cleans the lodge themselves. CHECK whether there's a laundry bag to make up, and whether a turnaround clean is actually needed.
